questions.question: This book belongs to Tom. It is _____.
questions.explanation_cn: 表示“他的（书）”，需要使用名词性物主代词 his。
questions.explanation_en: Use the possessive pronoun 'his' to show ownership.

questions.question: Sarah and I enjoyed _____ at the party.
questions.explanation_cn: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，因此用 ourselves。
questions.explanation_en: 'Enjoy oneself' is a fixed expression, so 'ourselves' is correct.

questions.question: _____ of the students passed the final exam.
questions.explanation_cn: Each of + 复数名词，表示“每一个”。Every 后面不能直接接 of。
questions.explanation_en: 'Each of' is correct. 'Every of' is incorrect.

questions.question: I have two brothers. _____ of them are doctors.
questions.explanation_en: Use 'both' when referring to two people together.

questions.question: Would you like _____ coffee?
questions.explanation_cn: 表示邀请或请求时，通常使用 some，而不是 any。
questions.explanation_en: In offers and requests, 'some' is usually preferred instead of 'any'.

questions.question: There isn't _____ milk left in the fridge.
questions.explanation_cn: 否定句中通常使用 any。
questions.explanation_en: 'Any' is commonly used in negative sentences.

questions.question: There are five students in the classroom. _____ student has a laptop.
questions.explanation_cn: Every 后面直接接单数名词；Each of 后面必须接复数名词。
questions.explanation_en: 'Every' is followed by a singular noun, while 'Each of' must be followed by a plural noun.

questions.question: I invited ten friends, but only _____ came.
questions.explanation_cn: a few 表示'有几个'；few 表示'几乎没有'，带否定含义。

questions.question: Neither of the answers _____ correct.
questions.explanation_cn: Neither 作主语通常看作单数，因此使用 is。
questions.explanation_en: 'Neither' is generally treated as singular, so 'is' is correct.

questions.question: The manager introduced _____ before starting the meeting.
questions.explanation_cn: 主语和宾语是同一个人时，应使用反身代词 himself。
questions.explanation_en: Use a reflexive pronoun when the subject and object are the same person.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: Every of the students passed the test.

questions.explanation_cn: A 正确：Each 后接单数名词。B 错误：应为 Each of the students 或 Every student。C 正确：Neither 通常视为单数。D 正确：表示邀请时通常使用 some。
questions.explanation_en: A is correct because 'Each' takes a singular noun. B is incorrect because 'Every of' is not grammatical. C is correct because 'Neither' is generally singular. D is correct because 'some' is preferred in offers.
